name: monitor
description: macOS only. A lightweight RAM/CPU recorder (launchd) toggled with /monitor, with live RAM, cache, swap and CPU shown above the prompt or in the status line. Logs stay on the Mac.

sampleSeconds.title: Sample interval (seconds)
sampleSeconds.description: How often the recorder samples and the display refreshes (2-300).

placement.title: Where to show it
placement.description: above-prompt: a fixed row above the input. status-line: an entry in the status line.

detailedLogs.title: Detailed logs
detailedLogs.description: Also log full executable paths of top processes and, when cmux is installed, their cmux workspace name (found by reading process environments with ps -axeww; only the name is stored). Off: only system numbers, app totals and process names.

hungApps.title: Check for hung apps under memory pressure
hungApps.description: When memory pressure is not normal, ask System Events (at most once a minute) which apps do not respond. Needs Automation permission.
